8ZpCaE
Problem Description
: Mainfan_GQ1
Troubleshooting
: As we reviewed the logs and error flags, it shows a Mainfan_GQ1 error.
Please find below the necessary checks to be conducted on-site to resolve the issue:
Usually, this error appears when there is no power reaching the fan.
Please check if from L3 which comes from FC20 we are getting the 230V
Then check the XD7.1B which is the connector above the SECCs. Check if we receive the 230V in the input and output of the connector.
If not, then please remove the connector and reinsert.
Inspect for any loose connections.
Examine the fan for any physical damage.
Additionally, please find the attached knowledge article link and MLFB for your reference.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_FAN_Error Flag_OK Signal Lost - Dynamics 365
8EM5903-0AA00-4AA2 -GQ1
For future reference, your case number is
0416429
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,

Mohini Patil
